text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "An seiner Sitzung vom 29. März 2023 hat er, basierend auf den Lehren aus der Corona-Pandemie, entschieden, die Organisation der Bundesverwaltung für künftige Krisen zu stärken.", "gist": "The Federal Council decided on March 29, 2023 to strengthen the federal administration's organization for future crises based on lessons from the COVID-19 pandemic."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Bundesrat", "gist": "Federal Council"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Krisenstab", "gist": "Crisis staff"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Departemente", "gist": "Federal departments"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "VBS", "gist": "Swiss Federal Department of Defence, Civil Protection and Sports"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Bundeskanzlei", "gist": "Federal Chancellery"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "Das VBS und die Bundeskanzlei mit der Ausarbeitung von Rechtsgrundlagen für die neue Krisenorganisation beauftragt", "gist": "The VBS and Federal Chancellery are tasked with drafting legal bases for the new crisis organization"}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "Bei komplexen Krisen kann der Bundesrat den Einsatz eines Krisenstabs auf politisch-strategischer und auf operativer Ebene beschliessen", "gist": "In complex crises, the Federal Council can decide to deploy a crisis staff at the political-strategic and operational levels"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Oberste leitende Behörde bleibt der Bundesrat", "gist": "The Federal Council remains the supreme leading authority"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Neu soll ausserdem ein Permanenter Kernstab die Stäbe der Departemente in der Krisenbewältigung unterstützen", "gist": "A new permanent core staff will additionally support the departments' staffs in crisis management"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "bis Ende 2023", "gist": "by the end of 2023"}]}
